rule: Phase 6 System Graph & Flow Intelligence units are pre-planned here. They are planning commitments, not implementation claims. No unit becomes ACTIVE without canonical stage alignment and the current active-plan gate.

units.name: Canonical System Graph
units.summary: Provider-neutral node/edge/evidence model for Nexora architecture, runtime, data, security, packages, releases, infrastructure, tests and operations.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical graph schemas separate declared/static/observed/tested/production-observed/AI-inferred evidence and can represent representative Core, Theme and Extension paths without creating duplicate telemetry sources.

units.name: Declared Architecture & Package Graph Provider
units.summary: Build graph assertions from public contracts, manifests, registries, capabilities, routes, slots, configuration, ownership and explicit architecture models.
acceptance_criteria: Declared package/module/runtime relationships are versioned, queryable and attributable to source registry/manifest/contracts.

units.name: Static Code & Data-Path Graph Provider
units.summary: AST/dependency/static/data-flow provider contract for call, dependency, source-to-sink and architecture-path evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Static findings retain analyzer/source/build provenance and never masquerade as observed runtime truth.

units.name: Runtime Flow Graph Provider
units.summary: Correlate requests, routes, middleware, services, hooks, DB/cache/network/jobs/errors and package spans into runtime-observed graph evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Representative Core/Theme/Extension request paths correlate to package/source identity with bounded overhead and sensitive-data redaction.

units.name: Data Lineage Flow Provider
units.summary: Project authoritative/derived stores, classifications, transformations, tenant ownership, retention and package/API/AI/external exposure into the graph.
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive data paths expose classification/ownership/purpose/retention metadata without exposing raw sensitive values.

units.name: Security & Trust Boundary Flow Provider
units.summary: Graph entry points, trust zones, auth/authz/capabilities, secrets, brokers, Sentinel findings, source-to-sink paths and architecture/security violations.
acceptance_criteria: Graph can identify representative unexpected trust-boundary/capability/network paths and link every finding to enforcement/evidence rather than visual inference alone.

units.name: Permission & Capability Decision Flow
units.summary: Explain actor role, tenant scope, human permission, policy/precondition, package capability, re-auth/approval and final allow/deny decision.
acceptance_criteria: Why-allowed/why-denied paths remain tenant scoped and preserve separation between human permissions and executable package capabilities.

units.name: Error & Failure Propagation Graph
units.summary: Correlate root exceptions, propagated/cascade failures, retries, fallbacks, reconciliation, dead-letter jobs and final outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Error views distinguish root, propagated, secondary and recovered failures without leaking stack/request secrets.

units.name: State, Transaction & Concurrency Flow
units.summary: Model state machines, allowed/invalid transitions, transaction/lock boundaries, idempotency, race windows, concurrency and reconciliation metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Representative stateful workflows show valid/invalid transitions and concurrency controls while a single trace is never used to prove race safety.

units.name: Theme / Extension / Module Flow Profiles
units.summary: Package-centric graph profile covering lifecycle, contracts, hooks, data, network, secrets, capabilities, assets, errors, performance and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A developer can inspect a Theme/Extension/module and see declared/observed contracts, capabilities, data/network/secret access, lifecycle and violations with exact package/version evidence.

units.name: System Graph Explorer
units.summary: Accessible Admin graph viewer with ecosystem/system/feature/execution zoom, collapse/expand, search, evidence badges and safe details panels.
acceptance_criteria: Basic Flow Explorer is readable on representative graphs, supports accessible non-color-only semantics and enforces separate sensitive graph permissions/redaction.

units.name: Nexora Flow Intelligence
units.summary: Advanced Flow Center combining graph query, history, diff, replay, impact, incident, quality/performance/reliability/payment/AI lenses and evidence-backed explanations.
acceptance_criteria: Flow Center can explain representative runtime/data/security/error/package flows and always exposes evidence class/provenance rather than an opaque AI-generated diagram.

units.name: Deployment & Infrastructure Flow
units.summary: Visualize environment topology, DNS/CDN/WAF/load-balancer/app/cache/DB/queue/storage/provider placement and configuration-dependent routing.
acceptance_criteria: Infrastructure topology is environment/version aware, authorization scoped and redacted so the Flow Center does not become an attacker reconnaissance console.

units.name: Supply Chain Flow Lens
units.summary: Connect packages to direct/transitive dependencies, artifacts, publishers, SBOM/provenance, advisories, licenses and runtime reachability evidence where available.
acceptance_criteria: Supply-chain findings remain evidence-backed; absence of observed reachability does not get presented as proof of safety.

units.name: Path-Aware Test & Evidence Coverage
units.summary: Overlay unit/integration/auth/security/E2E/performance/fault/production evidence on critical graph paths instead of relying only on line coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Critical path evidence gaps are visible as unknown/missing and never inferred PASS from unrelated coverage percentages.

units.name: Graph Diff, History & Time Travel
units.summary: Compare releases, package versions, branches and environments and retain first/last-seen evidence for graph changes within retention policy.
acceptance_criteria: Added/removed/changed nodes/edges/policies/network/data/capabilities/tests/performance can be compared with exact source/build/package/deployment identity.

units.name: Change Impact & Blast Radius
units.summary: Evidence-backed potential impact traversal from changed/failed/compromised nodes to contracts, packages, flows, tests, data, security, performance, SLOs and deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Impact results distinguish potential/inferred impact from observed/tested impact and preserve tenant/deployment authorization boundaries.

units.name: Runtime Replay & Incident Flow
units.summary: Visual replay of recorded traces plus root/cascade failure, containment, blast-radius, SLO and recovery/reconciliation views without re-executing production actions.
acceptance_criteria: Replay is read-only recorded evidence, incident data is privileged/audited, and root vs cascade failures are visually distinguishable.

units.name: Model-based What-if Analysis
units.summary: Predictive graph traversal for dependency/config/package/permission/provider failure scenarios using registered models and observed evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario results are explicitly labelled modelled/predicted and are never promoted to verified behavior without a test/observation.

units.name: Flow Explain
units.summary: Explain authorized graph nodes, edges, conditions and evidence in natural language without inventing hidden relationships.
acceptance_criteria: Explanations cite graph evidence classes and respect user/tenant/sensitive-field permissions.

units.name: Flow Root Cause Assistant
units.summary: Rank likely root causes from correlated runtime/error/performance/reliability graph evidence and separate cause from cascade symptoms.
acceptance_criteria: Root-cause output is confidence/evidence-labelled and never fabricates causal certainty from correlation alone.

units.name: Flow Security Path Assistant
units.summary: Explain trust-boundary/source-to-sink/package-capability/payment/AI attack paths grounded in authorized security evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The tool cannot expose restricted internal topology or label mere adjacency as an exploitable vulnerability without analyzer/runtime evidence.

units.name: Flow Change Impact Assistant
units.summary: Explain potential blast radius, evidence gaps and recommended verification for a code/package/config/release change.
acceptance_criteria: Impact explanations distinguish modelled, static, tested and observed paths and recommend verification rather than claiming unknown effects as fact.
